description: This file defines the Hyperlink class within PhpSpreadsheet, providing a static method to set hyperlinks on spreadsheet cells, implementing the HYPERLINK Excel function.

classes.name: Hyperlink
classes.description: Provides functionality to set hyperlinks in spreadsheet cells, corresponding to the Excel HYPERLINK function.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a hyperlink in a given cell with specified URL and display name, mimicking the Excel HYPERLINK function.
